title: Fair Without Leveling Down: A New Intersectional Fairness Definition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) parity across intersectional demographic subgroups (combining gender with other traits like race and age) on text and image classification datasets (Twitter Hate Speech, CelebA, Psychometric).

Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) parity across intersectional demographic subgroups (combining race or skin color with other traits) on Twitter Hate Speech, CelebA, and Psychometric classification datasets.

Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) parity across intersectional demographic subgroups (combining age with other traits) on Twitter Hate Speech, CelebA, and Psychometric datasets.
Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) parity across intersectional demographic subgroups (combining country with other traits) on the Twitter Hate Speech dataset.
Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) parity across intersectional demographic subgroups (combining income with other traits) on Psychometric text classification datasets.

Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) parity across intersectional demographic subgroups (using the 'Attractive' attribute combined with other traits) on the CelebA image classification dataset.
